_comment: Was TRANSFORM_HERO (Arakni's agent-of-chaos effect) with 'parts' and 'transform_to' keys that nothing read, so it called become_agent_of_chaos on a Mechanologist hero. Transform (CR 8.5.36) is all-or-nothing across every named part (8.5.36d), and the equipment lives in the slot zones, never in `permanents` -- a permanents-only scan finds none of it. 'If you don't, negate this' is exactly that all-or-nothing failure: when a part is missing nothing transforms.
